units.source_scale_reason: One fixed anatomical scale per original source matches the existing approximately 234px crown-to-ground ready silhouette and shoulder/chest dimensions. Planted hooves provide registration; no per-pose resizing or deformation.

visual_review.notes: Reviewed 48 original quadruped paintings at 128px battle scale. Forehoof/neck/jaw idle, grounded crown-jaw lunge/recovery, recoil, crown brace, raised-hoof call, grounded collapse and distinct near/far hoof steps. Six masters with fixed anatomical scales; full crown/tail margins and no duplicate padding or warping.
